name: Chad

fees.name: Chad e-Visa (short stay, all ordinary visa categories via evisa.td)
fees.validity: short-stay e-visa previously issued as 90-day multiple-entry; validity under new May 2026 tariff schedule not publicly enumerated
fees.applies: all nationalities not on Chad's visa-exempt list
fees.notes: Since 11 May 2026 ALL Chad visa applications (tourist, business, transit, etc.) must be made online via the official portal evisa.td under a new fee schedule (Arrete conjoint n.033/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/MSPI/2026); visas issued outside the platform after 21 May 2026 are invalid. The portal does NOT publish the new tariff grid publicly - fees are shown only inside the application flow - so amounts cannot be verified on an official source. At launch (2024-2025) the officially communicated price for the 90-day multiple-entry short-stay e-visa was EUR 100 / ~65,000 XAF (media reports of the official launch; travellers reported paying ~67,500 XAF incl. service charge), but this may have changed under the May 2026 grille tarifaire.

fees.name: Embassy sticker visa (discontinued)
fees.notes: Embassy-issued visas and manual entry authorisations were abolished effective 11/21 May 2026; only diplomatic and courtesy visas remain with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (free of charge). Embassy visas issued before that date remain valid until expiry.

fees.name: Visa on arrival / manual entry authorisation (abolished)
fees.notes: The official announcement states manual entry authorisations are definitively abolished ('les autorisations manuelles d'entree sur le territoire sont definitivement supprimees'); travellers must obtain the e-visa before arrival.

vfs.note: No outsourced visa application centre (VFS Global/TLScontact/BLS); applications are made directly on the government portal evisa.td.

free_visa_notes: Nationals of 24 states/territories are visa-exempt per the official portal: Barbados, Benin, Bermuda, Cameroon, Congo, Cote d'Ivoire, Dominica, Gabon, Gambia, Equatorial Guinea, Haiti, Mauritius, Cook Islands, Malaysia, Mali, Micronesia, Niger, Nigeria, Central African Republic, Rwanda, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Singapore, Suriname, Togo.
